_comment: Build recipe read by PocketBuilder from this repo (it reads repos whose name contains 'pocket': rename the repo to Pocket-COIPlanner). Keep it in sync with packaging/build_embedded.py and the README: if you change a build step, the version file, an artifact or the zip name, update this file in the same commit.
name: COI-Planner

release.title: COI Planner v{version}
release.notes: COI Planner as a program window (Edge WebView2; Windows 10/11). Install it from PocketApps, or unzip anywhere and double-click COI-Planner.cmd. Nothing is installed; everything it saves stays in the Data folder. It can install the game-data exporter mod for you and read its export (the mod is included when this was built on a PC that has the game). If the window will not open, COI-Planner-Browser.cmd opens it in Edge/Chrome. The bundled game data is older than the current game: use the Game data tab to bring in your own export.
